name: BEP (Bleomycin / Etoposide / CISplatin)
cyclesNote: 3 (IGCCCG good risk) or 4 (IGCCCG intermediate or poor risk); 1 cycle in the high-risk stage I NSGCT adjuvant setting

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: The cytotoxic BEP backbone is not biomarker-restricted. Serum tumor markers (AFP, beta-hCG, LDH) classify IGCCCG good, intermediate, and poor risk, which sets the number of cycles. A pure seminoma histology never elevates AFP (a rising AFP implies nonseminomatous elements). Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Testicular Cancer, Risk Classification for Advanced Disease (TEST-D).

stage: IB to IS (NSGCT, 1 cycle adjuvant BEP option)
histology: germ cell tumor (serves BOTH seminoma and nonseminomatous germ cell tumor / NSGCT)

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis (high emetic risk)
premedications.notes: CISplatin-containing multiday regimen is highly emetogenic; high-emetic-risk prophylaxis indicated.

premedications.name: Hydration
premedications.notes: IV pre- and post-hydration with each CISplatin dose.

supportiveCare: Antiemetics: high emetic risk (multiday CISplatin). Confirm exact institutional/guideline tier.
Nephroprotection: IV hydration and electrolyte repletion with each CISplatin dose.
Pulmonary: bleomycin cumulative-dose tracking (warn greater than 400 units lifetime) plus baseline and pre-cycle PFTs (DeVita 12th ed. line 27799 to 27808).
G-CSF: not routinely mandated for standard BEP; use per febrile-neutropenia risk assessment.
monitoring: Serum tumor markers (AFP, beta-hCG, LDH) before each cycle and at restaging
Renal function (creatinine/GFR) and electrolytes (Mg, K, Na) before each cycle - CISplatin
Ototoxicity and peripheral neuropathy assessment - CISplatin
Pulmonary function tests at baseline and before each cycle; assess for cough/dyspnea - bleomycin (DeVita line 27805 to 27808)

doseModificationRules.condition: greater than 15% decline in DLCO or vital capacity, or clinical pneumonitis
doseModificationRules.text: Discontinue bleomycin; consider switching to a bleomycin-free regimen (EP or VIP). Physician decides (DeVita line 27805 to 27808).

doseModificationRules.condition: rising creatinine / falling GFR, ototoxicity, or grade 2+ neuropathy
doseModificationRules.text: Review required; consider dose reduction or delay. Physician decides.
Cumulative pulmonary-risk threshold; review continuation and pulmonary status. Physician decides (DeVita line 27799).

drugs.name: Etoposide
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, TEST-E. Etoposide 100 mg/m2 IV Days 1 to 5. Corroborated by DeVita 12th ed. good-risk BEP (line 167554).

provenance.locator: First-Line Chemotherapy Regimens for Germ Cell Tumors (TEST-E), BEP (Etoposide 100 mg/m2 IV Days 1 to 5)

drugs.name: CISplatin
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, TEST-E. CISplatin 20 mg/m2 IV Days 1 to 5. ISMP tall-man. No lifetime cumulative cap; requires IV pre/post hydration; monitor nephrotoxicity, ototoxicity, peripheral neuropathy. Corroborated by DeVita 12th ed. (line 167555).

provenance.locator: First-Line Chemotherapy Regimens for Germ Cell Tumors (TEST-E), BEP (Cisplatin 20 mg/m2 IV Days 1 to 5)

drugs.name: Bleomycin
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v2.2026, TEST-E. Bleomycin 30 UNITS IV weekly on Days 1, 8, and 15 (or Days 2, 9, and 16). Dosed in UNITS, not mg/m2. CUMULATIVE PULMONARY CAP: risk of bleomycin pneumonitis (the dose-limiting toxicity) rises with cumulative dose greater than 400 units (DeVita 12th ed. line 27799). Obtain PFTs at baseline and before each cycle; a greater than 15% fall in DLCO or vital capacity mandates discontinuation (DeVita line 27805 to 27808). Consider a bleomycin-free regimen (EP or VIP) in patients at increased pulmonary risk (NCCN footnote u).

provenance.locator: First-Line Chemotherapy Regimens for Germ Cell Tumors (TEST-E), BEP (Bleomycin 30 units IV weekly on Days 1, 8, and 15 or Days 2, 9, and 16)
